tagline: Research a local business — notes, brand, and its Facebook, Instagram and TikTok posts — then generate a Lovable prompt for its new website.
summary: Design Prompter is a small CRM for consulting on local-business websites. Each customer gets a workspace with an overview, notes from texts, emails and calls, a brand identity (logo, colors, fonts) and their social presence.

It finds a business's Facebook, Instagram and TikTok pages for you (a Google search through Apify, then Claude picks the right URL), scrapes their recent posts, and finally turns everything it knows — customer details, notes and brand — into a versioned prompt you paste into Lovable to build the site.
audience: You design websites for local businesses and start each project by researching their online presence.
You build first drafts with Lovable (or a similar AI site builder) and want consistent, well-informed prompts.
You're fine running a single-user tool locally with Postgres.
notFor: A general sales CRM — no deals, pipeline or email sending.
Building the website itself — it produces the prompt; Lovable builds the site.
Teams — single-user, protected only by a shared `SERVICES_API_KEY`.

capabilities.title: Customer list
capabilities.detail: `/customers` lists the local businesses you're tracking, with service industry.

capabilities.title: Customer workspace
capabilities.detail: `/customer-detail-page` has tabs for overview, notes, brand and prompts, plus online profiles.

capabilities.title: Notes
capabilities.detail: Log texts, emails and calls per customer (`customer_notes`).

capabilities.title: Brand identity
capabilities.detail: Logo upload (stored on local disk, served from `/uploads/customer-assets/...`), colors and fonts (`customer_brand`).

capabilities.title: Social page discovery
capabilities.detail: Find the business's Facebook, Instagram and TikTok pages: Google SERP via Apify, then Claude resolves the right URL. Each run is audited.

capabilities.title: Post scraping
capabilities.detail: Pull recent Facebook, Instagram (up to 100, hidden posts stay hidden) and TikTok posts via Apify actors.

capabilities.title: Lovable prompt generation
capabilities.detail: `POST /api/services/generate-lovable-prompt` combines customer, notes and brand into a prompt; every version is kept in `customer_prompts`.

components.name: Web app
components.owns: Customer list and workspace UI. Server-side BFF routes call Express with `SERVICES_API_KEY`.

components.name: API
components.owns: Local Postgres `design_prompter`, customer CRUD (`/api/data/*`), discovery/scrape/prompt services (`/api/services/*`), logo uploads to `UPLOADS_DIR`.
components.doesNotOwn: Real auth — a single Bearer key.

dataFlow: Create `design_prompter` and apply `migrations/setup.sql` plus the numbered Instagram/TikTok migrations.
The web app's server routes call Express at `EXPRESS_API_URL` with `Authorization: Bearer <SERVICES_API_KEY>`.
Discovery: Express runs a Google SERP scrape on Apify, sends the results to Claude to pick the page URL, and saves it on the customer.
Scraping: Express runs the Facebook/Instagram/TikTok Apify actors and stores posts.
Prompt generation: Express gathers customer + notes + brand, calls Claude and saves the prompt version.

trust.title: Browser
trust.detail: Never sees `SERVICES_API_KEY` — it's added by the Next.js server.

trust.title: Express (your machine)
trust.detail: Holds `DATABASE_URL`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `APIFY_API_TOKEN`; logos are written to local disk.

trust.title: Apify / Anthropic
trust.detail: Receive business names, search results and your notes when you run discovery or generation.

commonTasks.title: First-time setup
steps: On the **API Express** repo, **Set up local database** to create `design_prompter` and apply migrations.
Set `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `APIFY_API_TOKEN` and `SERVICES_API_KEY` on the API; set the same `SERVICES_API_KEY` and `EXPRESS_API_URL` on the web.

commonTasks.title: Research a new customer
steps: Create the customer on `/customers` and open it.
Run Facebook, Instagram and TikTok discovery from the online profiles section, then scrape posts.
Add notes from your conversations and fill in the brand tab (logo, colors, fonts).

commonTasks.title: Generate a Lovable prompt
commonTasks.when: Research is done and you're ready to build.
steps: Open the customer's **Prompt** tab and generate.
Copy the prompt into Lovable. Regenerate after adding notes — older versions stay in history.

troubleshooting.symptom: Discovery finds nothing or the wrong page
troubleshooting.fix: Check `APIFY_API_TOKEN`; make the customer name and city specific. You can always set the page URL by hand.

troubleshooting.symptom: Uploaded logo shows a broken image
troubleshooting.fix: `PUBLIC_BASE_URL` must match the API's real URL/port so `/uploads/...` links resolve.

glossary.definition: Finding a business's social page URL via Google SERP + Claude.
A generated brief you paste into Lovable to build the customer's website.

hubNotes: The registry's `expectedTables` list only the Facebook tables; Instagram and TikTok tables (`customer_instagram_*`, `customer_tiktok_*`) also exist after migrations 003–005.
Logos live on local disk in the API's `UPLOADS_DIR` (default `./uploads`), not in a database or bucket — back it up with the repo folder.
Early-stage repos (2–3 commits); package names are still `nextjs-template` / `express-server-template`.
